english.title: Offer / expose controlled alcoholic products for sale intending to arrange a wholesale sale

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Alcohol; Alcohol duty; Approvals; Conditions; Controlled activities; HMRC Commissioners; Regulations; Restrictions; Wholesale trade

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person intending to arrange a wholesale sale of controlled alcoholic products, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TYPE OF ALCOHOLIC PRODUCTS..), and who was UK-established for the purposes of value added tax, carried on a controlled activity by arranging in the course of a trade or business, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TRADE OR BUSINESS..), for the controlled alcoholic products to be sold wholesale, or offered or exposed them for sale in circumstances in which the sale if made would have been a wholesale sale of the alcoholic products, otherwise than in accordance with an approval given by the Commissioners under section 100 of the Finance Act (No. 2) Act 2023
english.legislation: Contrary to section100(1) and 104(3)and (5) of the Finance (No. 2) Act 2023.
